input.description: Download logo and query WP media API

input.command:
cd /Users/stone/Downloads/fujitennka-logo && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

for name in ['media-logo.json', 'media-LOGO.json']:
    p = Path(name)
    print('===', name, 'size', p.stat().st_size)
    try:
        data = json.loads(p.read_text())
    except Exception as e:
        print('parse error', e)
        print(p.read_text()[:500])
        continue
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        print(data.keys())
        print(str(data)[:800])
        continue
    print('count', len(data))
    for item in data:
        src = item.get('source_url')
        title = (item.get('title') or {}).get('rendered')
        mime = item.get('mime_type')
        print(f'- {title} | {mime} | {src}')
        sizes = (item.get('media_details') or {}).get('sizes') or {}
        if 'full' in sizes:
            print('  full', sizes['full'].get('source_url'), sizes['full'].get('width'), sizes['full'].get('height'))
PY

input.command:
cd /Users/stone/Downloads/fujitennka-logo && python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import collections

for name in ['logo_2-01.png','fujitennka-mark.png','neo-q-logo.png','fujitennka-wordmark-cropped.png']:
    im = Image.open(name).convert('RGBA')
    extrema = im.getextrema()
    # sample unique colors
    colors = im.getcolors(maxcolors=500000)
    if colors is None:
        print(name, 'too many colors')
        continue
    colors = sorted(colors, key=lambda x: -x[0])[:8]
    print(f'\n{name} {im.size}')
    for count, rgba in colors:
        pct = 100*count/(im.size[0]*im.size[1])
        print(f'  {rgba}  {count:7} ({pct:5.1f}%)')
    # transparency
    alphas = [c[1][3] for c in colors]
    print('  alpha extrema', extrema[3])
PY
# tidy names
rm -f fujitennka-wordmark-aug.png
mv -f logo_2-01.png fujitennka-wordmark.png
ls -la

富士天嘉官网的 logo 已经下好了，都在 `~/Downloads/fujitennka-logo/`。

主文件是页头那套横版：图形标 +「株式会社富士天嘉 / FU JI TEN KA Co., Ltd.」，透明底 PNG，原图 **1343×459**。品牌蓝大约是 `#19327D`。站上没有 SVG。

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `fujitennka-wordmark.png` | 官网页头/页脚原图，透明底 |
| `fujitennka-wordmark-cropped.png` | 同一套，上下裁过一刀 |
| `fujitennka-mark.png` | 单独图形标，313×313，透明底 |
| `neo-q-logo.png` | NEO-Q 印刷标，500×500，白底 |

Finder 里已经打开了这个文件夹。
